verdict.rationale: Crossplane documents that Composition Functions let you write configuration in Python and Go (plus KCL and YAML) as a pipeline of functions, and its CLI can render and test functions locally. So general-purpose languages are available, but only through the function pipeline layered on Kubernetes resources, and community comments describe Crossplane mainly as YAML-based. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of type-checked infrastructure definitions, loops and abstractions, IDE support or editor tooling, and independent hands-on corroboration of authoring infrastructure in Python or Go.
